items.text: As first time homeowners, my fiancee and I were very nervous about taking such a major step in our lives. Joe Goretskie, my realtor, was truly a godsend. Any question I had, he was there with an answer and made me feel at ease. Joe, Aaron, Jeff and everyone else at Green Light were great. I'd recommend Joe and Green Light to anyone in the market for a new home. In fact, I've given Joe's business cards out to several of my friends. Thank you Green Light Realty for making our dream a reality. You guys are the best.

data.title: About Joseph
bio: Joseph Goretskie grew up in Old Bridge and now resides with his wife and two kids in Sayreville.  He works for Old Bridge Township and therefore is very familiar with Middlesex County.

He attended East Brunswick Votech School as a teen, and has since kept a finger on the pulse of the life of an honest tradesman.  His energy, charisma and experience with investment properties are the kind of keys any salesperson would like to have in their pocket.
His warm loveable character and quick wit are what sets him apart from the rest.  Call today at (732)-266-7246 to get in touch!
